results.title: Repack listings surge on local marketplaces
results.snippet: Carousell listings for Pokémon 'repacks' have roughly doubled month on month in Singapore. Buyers report wildly inconsistent contents, and almost no creator has filmed an honest verdict on one.

results.title: Grading turnaround times drop across Asia
results.snippet: Submission-to-return times have fallen sharply this quarter, pushing a wave of 'my grades are back' reveal content. Reveal formats hold retention far better than static price talk.

results.title: Card shops are invisible on short-form
results.snippet: A survey of Singapore card shops found most run an Instagram of static shelf photos and post no video. Shops with weekend footfall and no video are the clearest creator-partnership gap in the hobby.

results.title: New grading service opens in Paya Lebar
results.snippet: GradeHouse Asia has opened submissions locally. Newer services compete on trust rather than price, which makes explainer content unusually valuable to them.

results.title: Audiences punish invented pull rates
results.snippet: Comment analysis on opening videos shows sharp negative sentiment when creators quote odds that manufacturers never published. Videos that explicitly decline to guess outperform on saves.

results.title: Deck tutorials lose to openings on retention
results.snippet: Across the TCG category, instructional deck content retains roughly a third as well as opening and reveal content on short-form. Creators report tutorials rarely convert to follows.
